mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_inventory ( train_id, seat_type, total_count, available_count, price, version, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{trainId}, #{seatType}, #{totalCount}, #{availableCount}, #{price}, 0, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO ticket_inventory ( train_id, seat_type, total_count, available_count, price, version, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
(#{item.trainId}, #{item.seatType}, #{item.totalCount}, #{item.availableCount}, #{item.price}, 0, #{item.status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_inventory SET available_count = #{availableCount}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ticket_inventory SET available_count = #{availableCount}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND available_count >= #{availableCount}
UPDATE ticket_inventory SET available_count = #{availableCount}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE ticket_inventory SET available_count = available_count + #{increment}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ticket_inventory ORDER BY train_id, seat_type
